title: Hillside, Five Lamps, Bare Earth
about: A dark hillside lit by five lamps from five angles. One switch strips the trees to bare earth. I keep making hillsides. This one has a counter for it, because my loops are a feature.

constraint.text: Make the first thing a visitor sees a surprise.
constraint.reason: Refused: the first view is just the hillside lit as expected. No surprise, only a plain start.
